fre-business-tax.notes: Fees (apply page): $30 commercial and home-based; $125 licensed contractors; plus $4 state-mandated fee. Online (HdL PrimeWeb) is available for most businesses but NOT for food trucks, peddlers, massage, barbers/beauty salons, child care, non-profits and others; those use the fillable paper form. Paper form is rev 09/2018 and the 'Health Dept. (567-6700)' review row means Alameda County EH reviews food businesses. Check exemption eligibility first. In-person counter: 39550 Liberty Street, Fremont, CA 94538.

cup-building.notes: Library says 'portal', but the Accela portal (aca.accela.com/CUPERTINO) is only for instant permits, payment and inspections; standard permits (incl. commercial TI) go by email with a Dropbox link or at the Building Counter, 10300 Torre Avenue. Form PDF seen is rev 01/01/21 and prints permitcenter@cupertino.org; the current page says @cupertino.gov. The current forms page links a newer file (v/6 building-construction-permit-application.pdf) that could not be opened (403); re-check for a newer revision. Plan review fees due before review starts. Typical commercial TI timeline 15 days initial, 10 resubmittal; currently 20-30 business days.
